label: Vung Tau
short_description: The closest beach city to Ho Chi Minh City, on a peninsula about 1.5-2 hours southeast by road.
intro: Vung Tau's hotels in this directory serve the closest beach getaway from Ho Chi Minh City, roughly 1.5-2 hours away by car or hydrofoil, which makes the city a popular weekend and short-break destination for Saigon residents and business travelers alike rather than a long-haul resort market. Coverage centers on the Back Beach (Bai Sau) strip, where the city's few international-standard towers sit alongside a long run of local hotels. Expect a mix of leisure and MICE demand -- convention space and function rooms feature prominently -- rather than the villa-resort format found further up the coast.
